verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no batch or bulk endpoint for running operations across many items in one call. The async parameter only lets a single search be submitted and retrieved later, a building block a developer would loop over. Comma-separated multi-value parameters (multiple departure airports, multiple advertiser IDs) are narrow per-engine filters, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
